package.description: A modern editor/word processor, perfect for R statistical language.

en-US.description: A modern editor/word processor, perfect for R statistical language.
en-US.longDescription:
The Tinn-R is an editor/word processor ASCII/UNICODE generic for the Windows operating system, very well integrated into the R, with characteristics of Graphical User Interface (GUI) and Integrated Development Environment (IDE). It is a project registered under the General Public License GPL, that is, an open source software.
Tinn-R is an academical initiative, initiated and managed by D.Sc. José Cláudio Faria from the Laboratory of Computational Statistics (LEC) belonging to the State University of Santa Cruz (UESC).
en-US.name: Tinn-R

zh-CN.description: 一款完美适配 R 统计语言的现代编辑器/文字处理软件。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Tinn-R 是一款适用于 Windows 操作系统的编辑器/文字处理器，支持 ASCII/UNICODE 编码，与 R 语言紧密集成，并兼具图形用户界面（GUI）和集成开发环境（IDE）的特色。这是一个在通用公共许可证（GPL）下注册的项目，也就是说，这是一个开源软件。
Tinn-R 是一个学术倡议，由圣克鲁兹州立大学（UESC，State University of Santa Cruz）计算统计实验室（LEC）的理学博士 José Cláudio Faria 发起并管理。
zh-CN.name: Tinn-R
